events.title: Iran Conflict Escalation
events.summary: The ongoing conflict between the US and Iran is escalating, with potential for further military action. This could lead to increased volatility in the oil market and global stock markets. The US has shown military strength, but also its waning geopolitical power.
events.reasoning: The conflict escalation could lead to increased oil prices, which would negatively impact the oil services sector. On the other hand, the US stock market could see a boost from the perceived show of military strength.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil prices and US-Iran relations

events.exitStrategy: Exit when oil prices stabilize or US-Iran relations improve

events.title: Fed Holds Interest Rates Steady
events.summary: The Federal Reserve has decided to hold interest rates steady, despite high inflation. This decision could lead to increased volatility in the stock market and impact the value of the US dollar.

actions.label: BUY
actions.target: Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund (UUP)

events.reasoning: The decision to hold interest rates steady could lead to a decrease in the value of the US dollar, which would negatively impact the US stock market. On the other hand, the US dollar could see a boost from the perceived stability of the US economy.

timeFrame.note: Monitor US economic data and interest rates

events.exitStrategy: Exit when interest rates change or US economic data improves
